supplemental_read_only_routing_audit.method: Read source and run in-memory CLI probes using a fake Board and mocked work.py boundary calls; no Git/network or production board operations.
supplemental_read_only_routing_audit.direct_board_say_without_save: body has no save and save_of interprets it as shared
supplemental_read_only_routing_audit.direct_board_view_without_save: all-save public aggregate; private messages remain absent
supplemental_read_only_routing_audit.start_route: Source and real-clone regression confirm start passes --save explicitly to the board view.
supplemental_read_only_routing_audit.pending_retry_discard: No --save is passed intentionally: pending lists the local outbox; retry/discard use an explicit original message ID and sender identity. Retry preserves the stored body/save rather than rerouting to the active topic.
